newsitem.title: USA: TJX CFO sees FY'97 EPS at $2.85.
newsitem.headline: TJX CFO sees FY'97 EPS at $2.85.

text.p: TJX Cos Chief Financial Officer Donald Campbell said on Tuesday the discount retailer was benefiting from rising sales and interest savings and would likely post earnings of $2.85 a share for the fiscal year ending next January.
The company, a specialist in off-price retailing, earned $2.36 a share in its last fiscal year.
"We can achieve $2.85," Campbell said at an investment conference sponsored by Robert James & Associates Inc.

According to First Call, industry analysts are forecasting TJX, operator of Marshall's and the TJ Maxx stores, will earn between $2.65 and $2.90 a share in the current fiscal year. The mean estimate is $2.82.
Campbell said the company's earnings forecast was based on conservative predictions of rises in same-store sales, a key determinant of financial performance in retailing.
